testing_summary: No tests executed during review phase per pipeline boundary rules; test file changes reviewed through source inspection only.
risk_rationale: The change is a well-bounded, additive modification that adds a 960px intermediate photo width to LANDING_PHOTO_WIDTHS, filling the gap between 640px and 1280px at the 768px layout breakpoint. This is the explicitly authorized root cause fix for the Core Web Vitals issue. All code paths that reference LANDING_PHOTO_WIDTHS (landingPhotoSrcSet, LandingPhoto component, test assertions) work correctly with three widths; the change is purely additive with no removal or modification of existing 640/1280 behavior.
